companion objects that only hold an era's instances, constructors or the Scala `Ordering` of a type whose order the reference derives

objects that stand for the reference's modules of functions (`Alonzo/Scripts.hs`, `State/UTxO.hs`, `Shelley/UTxO.hs`, `Mary/UTxO.hs`, `Babbage/UTxO.hs`, `Alonzo/Tx.hs`, the `TxInfo.hs` and `Context.hs` of the script context, the `Indexable` instances of `Alonzo/TxBody.hs`, plutus-ledger-api's `V1` to `V4`, plutus-tx's `Ratio`), which Scala needs to hold top-level functions under a name

the summoners of the classes `ToPlutusData` and plutus-tx's `ToData`, and their syntax as a method, which Haskell needs none of: `toPlutusData x` and `toBuiltinData x` are the classes' own functions (#85)

values the reference computes lazily or shares, made once here (#85): the scripts of getReferenceScriptsNonDistinct without their hashes, which txNonDistinctRefScriptsSize reads without forcing the lazy hashes; and each script context's info as data (TxInfo's toData), made once for the scripts of a transaction that hold its one info; each language's view of one set of parameters, encoded once for the rules of a block (LanguageViews, mkScriptIntegrity with them, which getLanguageView's are by default); and each language's cost model read once for a transaction's scripts (lookupCostModel in a reading of the models)
